Provides functions for defining survival distributions,
modifying/combining them, and generating predictions.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_hazards()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/add_hazards.md)
  : Add Hazards
- [`apply_af()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/apply_af.md)
  : Apply Acceleration Factor
- [`apply_hr()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/apply_hr.md)
  : Apply Hazard Ratio
- [`apply_or()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/apply_or.md)
  : Apply Odds Ratio
- [`apply_shift()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/apply_shift.md)
  : Apply Fixed Shift in Time
- [`apply_td_hr()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/apply_td_hr.md)
  : Apply Time-Dependent Hazard Ratio
- [`define_surv_cure()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_cure.md)
  : Define Parametric Mixture or Non-Mixture Cure Distribution
- [`define_surv_flexsurv()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_flexsurv.md)
  : Define Parametric Distribution (flexsurv Parameterization)
- [`define_surv_fp()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_fp.md)
  : Define Fractional Polynomial Survival Distribution
- [`define_surv_func()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_func.md)
  : Define survival distribution based on a function
- [`define_surv_km()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_km.md)
  : Define Kaplan-Meier Distribution
- [`define_surv_lifereg()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_lifereg.md)
  : Define Parametric Distribution from SAS PROC LIFEREG Parameters
- [`define_surv_lifetable()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_lifetable.md)
  : Define Life-Table Distribution
- [`define_surv_param()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_param.md)
  : Define Parametric Distribution
- [`define_surv_spline()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_spline.md)
  [`define_spline_survival()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_spline.md)
  : Define Royston & Parmar Spline Survival Distribution
- [`define_surv_streg()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_streg.md)
  : Define Parametric Distribution from Stata streg Parameters
- [`define_surv_survreg()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/define_surv_survreg.md)
  : Define Parametric Distribution from survreg Parameters
- [`event_prob()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/event_prob.md)
  : Evaluate Event Probabilities
- [`join()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/join.md)
  : Join Distributions
- [`max_hazards()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/max_hazards.md)
  : Maximum Hazards
- [`mix()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/mix.md)
  : Mix Two or More Survival Distributions
- [`set_covariates()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/set_covariates.md)
  : Set Covariates of a Survival Model
- [`surv_prob()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/surv_prob.md)
  : Evaluate Survival Probabilities
- [`surv_quantile()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/surv_quantile.md)
  : Evaluate Survival Quantiles
- [`surv_random()`](https://policyanalysisinc.github.io/openqalysurv/reference/surv_random.md)
  : Generate Random Survival Times
